ymm4craft.config.title: YMM4Craft Settings
ymm4craft.config.link.tooltip: Connects automatically on the title screen while YMM4 is waiting.
ymm4craft.config.record.tooltip:
Records your play so you can re-shoot it from any camera in YMM4.
Everything you receive, such as chat, is recorded too.
ymm4craft.config.record.multiplayer.tool:
Records servers, LAN and Realms.
Some servers forbid recording, so check their rules.
ymm4craft.config.record.notify.tooltip: Shows a chat message only you can see when recording starts.
ymm4craft.screen.title: YMM4Craft
ymm4craft.screen.status.waiting:
YMM4 is waiting for a connection.
Press "Connect to YMM4" to use this game from YMM4.
ymm4craft.screen.status.none:
No YMM4 is waiting.
Place a YMM4Craft scene in YMM4 to connect from here.
ymm4craft.screen.status.version:
YMM4 is waiting, but the plugin and the mod versions do not match.
Use the same version for both.
